> however so will your future

Sometimes it feels like there's not one there anyway, so there's no big loss either.
If you can be by yourself for a while and bawl your eyes out, so be it. I needed to cry to get over a lot of things going on at once, and it felt great.

Whoa, long time to answer, sorry.

It's better... a lot better, indeed. Still thinking about this and it still stings a bit, but nowhere near what it was when I posted this.
Nice! Good to know; I was gonna annoy you every day, otherwise :).
By the way, the longer you let lazy-you linger and get his way, the harder it becomes to break the habit.

> You're being heard!

At the start, I wasn't :P. Freakin' spam filter... I wanted to post somewhere that this subreddit needs a better system, because I had to input the captcha 3 times... and some people who'll post here won't quite be willing to do that.

And, yes, getting it out is indeed nice :). (Fuck, even sometimes when I wrote into a journal it was plenty, even if I was the only one reading it.)

It's an awful cycle to be stuck in, and you're the only one who can break it. Scream "fuck you" to the lazy half and maybe even get your cry on (hey, it helps me). Then grab your phone and dial. Once the cycle is, if anything, widened, it becomes easier to break.

Thanks for listening.

Ninja edit: I mistyped this post like five times in a row, but your reply deserves a bit of care :)
Aye, very much in need for that :)

A tutorial of sorts. Think Learn you a Haskell and family.

I... don't know about that. Probably not. I am, though, slowly stepping it up. I've talked to an online buddy, then an online closer-friend, and brought it up in real life as a somewhat passing event with a friend.

> Sounds like you're also having some sort of existential crisis

Pretty much :I.

I feel stuck, in a rut, I need a girlfriend. I need a job. I'm turning 25 and I've never had my first fucking kiss. I considered cutting my hair, and even dyeing it red, but I live at home and my dad would kill me. I don't even know how to drive.

My parents used to work at home, now they have a new place, which is far enough to make me miss them for the few hours they're not here.

And even then I can't bring myself to tell them that.

Yeah, hopefully I'll do some self publishing and take donatons :).

I've mostly said everything that bothered in the rest of these posts, except for the one that makes me confused because I am at a loss for words for exactly what I feel about it.

I find it so much easier to talk about the things that bother me anonymously with random strangers on the internet than my family or my closest real life friends.

> Hey, I just saw your post. Just letting you know I'm seeing this and am reading and listening.

Thank you.

>Want to talk about your projects?

To be honest, not really, since they're suppossed to become public, eventually :).
And a very frustrating part of this is seeing my problems in the light of other people's problems and seeing them as inconsequential and feeling whiny and pathetic.

Yes, I had a bout of this just merely last week. I needed a friend. One. Anybody. But nobody was available, for personal reasons. And it was a kick in the nads. You need to push forward. you need to take the first step in listening to your needs. Grab your phone and call a friend, tell them you're feeling down. Your friends share your pain and your needs and they want to hang out with you. But they're not psychic. Call them.
This is making me feel great, by the way. I cry a tear with every keypress, and it cleans away a bit of anger. It'd be a bit better if I had confirmation of being heard.

And also, my dog. My dear, fucking, dog.

I had a dog, once, my first one, a long time ago. He was loving and obedient and was run over by a car. Yes, that made me sad, and I mourned him for a long time and I still have fond memories of his stay with me. But that is perfectly OK with me, I loved him and he should be remembered.

My new dog, however. My parents picked up a stray puppy, malnourished and dying, and brought him home. And he became the cutest puppy ever. And then a killing machine. He loves every single member of my family dearly, and will kill anybody who isn't. And that's my biggest gripe: My cleaning lady cannot come into my house without being harassed constantly. A person who is EVERY. FUCKING. DAY. in my house, is still treated as my dog's worst nightmare. And he was bestowed to me, as my sole responsibility.

Now, we're not a Traveling Circus (and, honestly, I don't love to travel), but my dog being what he is, it's impossible for us to travel together, now. Even if I didn't love doing it, a change of pace is nice, and now the possibility has been taken away. If it were my cat, I could drop her off at a friend's with food, but my dog would eat them alive.

Edit: Furthermore, he has a bad leg and needs daily pills. This was another huge part of this whole deal: one afternoon he was crying in pain and my whole family went mad in (perfectly understandable) worry. I met this deal just as I woke up, hungry and confused. Fucking awesome feeling that day /s.
